title: PiKVM Out-of-Band Remote Management & USB 3.0 Optimization
subtitle: Raspberry Pi 4B IP-KVM deployment controlling a Dell OptiPlex 3050 with custom udev capture pipeline tuning
stats: PiKVM • Raspberry Pi 4B • USB 3.0 Capture • Dell OptiPlex 3050
summary: Engineered an out-of-band IP-KVM solution using PiKVM on a Raspberry Pi 4B (4GB) to manage a Dell OptiPlex 3050 host. Reconfigured the underlying Linux kernel video capture pipeline via custom udev rule overrides to unlock full USB 3.0 throughput and reduce streaming latency.
highlights: Deployed PiKVM on a Raspberry Pi 4B (4GB) for out-of-band remote administration, enabling BIOS-level access, virtual media installation, and hardware-level control of a Dell OptiPlex 3050.
Bypassed default KVMD hardware checks by modifying `/lib/udev/rules.d/99-kvmd.rules` to force video capture device binding directly across the higher-speed USB 3.0 bus.
Hardened modified system udev rules with read-only file permissions (`chmod 444`) to guarantee configuration persistence across upstream package updates.
Configured low-latency video streaming and keyboard/mouse emulation for seamless headless system management.

techSpecs.Key Optimization: Custom udev video rules & USB 3.0 bandwidth unlocking
